description: This file defines the interface for HDMI CEC source control within the WPEFramework, including device management, status queries, configuration, and event notifications.

classes.name: IHdmiCecSource
classes.description: Interface for controlling HDMI CEC source devices, including device management, status retrieval, configuration, and event notifications.

classes.name: IHdmiCecSource::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for HDMI CEC events such as device added, removed, info updated, and key events.

classes.name: HdmiCecSourceDevices
classes.description: Structure representing a HDMI CEC device with logical address, vendor ID, and OSD name.

classes.name: HdmiCecSourceSuccess
classes.description: Structure indicating success status of HDMI CEC operations.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification handler for HDMI CEC events.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the HDMI CEC source with the given service.

methods.name: GetActiveSourceStatus
methods.description: Retrieves whether the device is the current active source.

methods.name: GetEnabled
methods.description: Checks if HDMI CEC is enabled.

methods.name: GetOSDName
methods.description: Retrieves the On-Screen Display name of the HDMI CEC source.

methods.name: GetOTPEnabled
methods.description: Checks if OTP is enabled for the HDMI CEC source.

methods.name: GetVendorId
methods.description: Retrieves the vendor ID of the HDMI CEC source.

methods.name: SendKeyPressEvent
methods.description: Sends a key press event to a CEC device.

methods.name: SendStandbyMessage
methods.description: Sends a standby message to a CEC device.

methods.name: SetEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled status of the HDMI CEC source.

methods.name: SetOSDName
methods.description: Sets the OSD name of the HDMI CEC source.

methods.name: GetDeviceList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of connected HDMI CEC devices.
